messages:
ryan: ACME reported p99 jumping ~4x at ~14:00 UTC during their billing batch. Customers seeing 504/timeouts. Opening escalation. sample req id r_9c3d

maya: do we have errors? p95 also up?

ryan: mostly tail (p99) but p95 creeping. Some requests get 200s after 8-12s. Example: r_9c3d

jon: checking pool metrics -> dedicated-acme pool at 100% provisioned vGPU capacity, attach backlog spiked after 13:58. Autoscaler tried to burst to shared but hit fairshare limit. Attach queue grew quickly.

provision-bot: burst request: 12 nodes requested -> 6 accepted to shared-pool (rate-limit). warmup_estimate=65s, image_pull=20-30s

priya: any recent deploys or image bumps?

infra-bot: deploy: kernel-image v2.15.0 rolled to us-east-1 13:40 UTC

jon: logs show a recurring image pull stall on new hosts (slow tar extraction from NFS), plus GPU driver probe occasionally retries -> adds 25-40s extra.

```
[2026-04-02T13:59:12Z] attach: req=r_9c3d pool=dedicated-acme
[2026-04-02T13:59:22Z] node-start: pull kernel-image v2.15.0
[2026-04-02T14:00:01Z] image-extract: waiting on NFS read (timeout retry)
[2026-04-02T14:00:45Z] gpu-init: driver probe retry (#3)
```

ryan: customer says this coincides with their hourly billing batch. They ran a short ~20k calls job at 14:00.

maya: any quick mitigations we can do to reduce tail? maybe route ACME to a smaller quantized model or to hosted pooled nodes.

jon: options:
- temporarily up min_warm_nodes for dedicated-acme (fast but warm takes ~70s)
- allow ACME to burst to shared-pool by increasing their fairshare weight for 5 minutes
- soft-fallback: route requests >600ms to hosted-compact model (lower cost/latency)

ryan: what's easiest to implement now?

jon: I'll increase fairshare for ACME and trigger two manual warm node attachments and prefetch kernel-image to cache. priya can coordinate hosted fallback route with API proxies.

provision-bot: manual warm attach started (2 nodes). prefetch kernel-image push -> started.

autoscaler-bot: fairshare override applied for tenant ACME for 10m.

jon: after manual warm nodes come up, p99 dropped from ~3.8s -> 700ms for new requests. Attach queue cleared in ~2m.

priya: implemented a proxy rule to fallback to hosted-compact for requests tagged with header X-ACME-Fallback when attach latency >500ms.

ryan: customer confirms improvement; tail still has some retries caused by client-side 3 retry policy.

maya: follow-ups to prevent recurrence:
- investigate NFS extraction stalls: move kernel-image storage off NFS or add local registry cache + checksum validation (INFRA-1188)
- reduce cold init time: parallelize driver probe + image-extract; add staged KV-cache prefetch (ENG-RUN-457)
- telemetry/alerts: alert when attach_queue > 40 for > 2m; also detect billing-window traffic spikes via tenant pattern and auto-scale earlier
- create preemptive warmup policy based on scheduled billing windows for priority tenants

jon: filed INFRA-1188 with logs and proposed fix; assigning to priya and infra team.

priya: ack. will draft runbook: priority-tenant warmup, temporary fairshare bump steps, hosted-fallback toggle.

ryan: I'll send a customer update summarizing mitigations and ETA for permanent fixes.

maya: good job. closing the live escalation for now — will monitor 1h. :thumbsup:
